description: The official My Hero Academia U.A. Entrance Exam module for Chronos Core. Face the faux-villain robots in the mock city, earn rescue points, and clear the 0-Pointer to win admission into the Hero Course.

node_01_guardian_gate.title: Exam Gate: The U.A. Arena Entrance
node_01_guardian_gate.description: Giant doors grind open to reveal the mock city district. Present Mic's voice booms instructions over the speakers: ten minutes, robots worth one to three points, your hero analysis goes live. A 1-Pointer lumbers into view, guarding the first intersection.

node_02_puzzle_cityblock.title: Mock City Center: Rescue-Point Scramble
node_02_puzzle_cityblock.description: Smoke rises from collapsing storefronts. A student lies pinned under rubble while a 2-Pointer advances on their position. Heroism here is measured not just by robots destroyed but by the lives saved — rescue points are tallied separately.

node_03_setback_swarm.title: Industrial Alley: The 0-Point Warning
node_03_setback_swarm.description: A synthetic voice warns of the 0-Pointer—worth zero points, designed to wreck anything in its path. A swarm of 1-Pointers corners a panicked examinee near the alley mouth. Stand and fight, or pull them clear and reposition?

node_04_climax_zeropointer.title: Central Plaza: The 0-Pointer
node_04_climax_zeropointer.description: The ground shakes. A colossal 0-Pointer towers over the plaza, its stamping feet collapsing rooftops. Deku's signature move — a single, reckless, full-power smash — is the stuff of legend here. Prove your own resolve, or find another way through.

node_05_reward_admission.title: Exam Results: Admission to the Hero Course
node_05_reward_admission.description: The clock hits zero. Recovery Girl tends the wounded as Present Mic announces the scoreboard. Villain points meet rescue points on the ledger — and for those who acted as true heroes, the admission letter to U.A. High School awaits.
